name: Concussive Blows: stun and follow-up magic window
targetName: one Concussive Blows stun and four-second follow-up window
objective: Investigate high one Concussive Blows stun and four-second follow-up window output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
mechanic: The level table gives 186 magic on a level-18 four-stack detonation, with follow-up Braum attacks dealing 40% of that base during the same-target stack immunity period. Neither helper has an AD or AP coefficient. Attack frequency, magic penetration and eligible amplification are the experiment; AP alone does not grow the core flat damage.
finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 10000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 4s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Three real Concussive Blows stacks already valid on the scored champion; one fourth attack starts the measured stun event. Riftmaker legally pre-ramped, Exactly six earned Lethal Tempo stacks, four earned Rageblade stacks and ten earned Legend: Alacrity stacks. Prepare the attack stacks through real attacks across two victims while leaving the scored victim at three valid passive stacks; record current AS and stack timers. Lethal Tempo and item damage are excluded from the passive-only total. Count subsequent actual Braum attacks during the four-second immunity window, excluding a boundary hit after immunity ends. Record actual start HP after preparation; no ally attacks.
test: Compare one detonation and counted follow-up passive packets, isolating normal attacks and item on-hits. Swap AS against penetration and AP as a negative core-ratio control. Test whether a phantom on-hit can trigger an extra passive follow-up rather than granting one automatically.
limits: No repeated full stun detonation on every attack, AP ratio invented, full Nashor/Rageblade damage labeled as passive or indefinite immunity duration. Actual follow-up eligibility, attack count and proc amplification need client checks.
tradeoff: A magic-penetration attack build sacrifices Braum normal durability and needs sustained melee contact after stack preparation.

setup: Preserve six real Lethal Tempo stacks, ten earned Alacrity stacks, four earned Rageblade stacks and three valid target passive stacks exactly as authored. Log all stack expiries and the actual AS cap; preparation must remain legal across two victims.

name: Eulogy of the Isles: Maiden maximum HP
targetName: Maiden maximum health from one legal summon
objective: Investigate high Maiden maximum health from one legal summon output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
mechanic: The Maiden health helper is a champion-level breakpoint base plus 60% of Yorick bonus HP. Her magic damage uses a separate 50/75/100 + 0.3 bonus AD helper; the mark damage and Mist Walkers are separate effects. This experiment scores Maiden maximum HP, not owner HP or total pet damage.
finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Exactly 500 earned Heartsteel HP, owner at full health, Protoplasm Lifeline inactive. One legal R summons one Maiden; record owner bonus HP and Maiden maximum/current HP immediately after summon, with no damage or allied pet buffs. Record actual level-18 breakpoint base from the client. Exactly 30 legally earned Grasp procs and 150 absorbed Overgrowth unit deaths; record actual rune HP and form-appropriate Grasp gains, not an invented flat HP bonus.
test: Swap HP slots while keeping level/earned stacks fixed. Compare maximum HP immediately at summon and after a stat change to establish snapshot versus dynamic scaling. Test a legally earned temporary Protoplasm max-HP state separately, observing what remains after it expires.
limits: No owner total HP substituted for bonus HP, both owner and Maiden health summed as one unit, damage/mark percent added as HP or temporary HP snapshot assumed permanent. No extra Maidens or unearned Heartsteel stacks.
tradeoff: A huge Maiden can cost Yorick personal offense or resists, and pet pathing, focus fire and control can matter more than the raw health number.
